hero.prompt: An ancient ornate throne standing alone on a sweeping cosmic plain under a vast night sky, the throne radiating a warm inherited golden glow as if lit from within by generations of ancestral presence, translucent ancestor spirit forms rising as luminous teal-and-gold mist from the dark earth around the throne's base, the mist curling upward like sacred smoke dissolving into the indigo heavens, a faint crescent arc hanging low in the far distance — deep indigo-to-near-black palette (#16112c fading to #0b0a1b), soft gold accents (#d4af6a), teal-and-gold nebula wash, painterly editorial illustration, full-bleed wide 16:9 composition that fills the entire frame, ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
hero.altEn: An ancient throne glowing with inherited gold in a vast night landscape, ancestor spirits rising as mist around it
hero.altZh: 广袤黑夜中一座散发着继承之光的古老王座，祖先群灵化作薄雾在其周围升腾

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Magha in a Chart
inline.altEn: Five-step sequence for reading Magha nakshatra in a birth chart
inline.altZh: 识别玛迦星宿的五步流程图

items.subEn: Magha spans 0° to 13°20' of Leo, the first slice of the sign
items.subZh: 它占狮子座 0° 到 13°20′，是这个星座最前面的一段

items.subEn: Read the placement through lineage and the past, not raw ambition
items.subZh: 透过血脉与过去来读这个位置，而非赤裸的野心

items.subEn: Ask what family legacy, name, or inheritance the chart asks to honor
items.subZh: 追问星盘在请这个人承接什么样的家族传承、名号或继承

items.subEn: Duty alongside letting go — the core of the reading, not a flaw
items.subZh: 一边被责任拉、一边被放下拉——这是解读的核心，而非缺陷

items.subEn: Authority received and reckoned with, not merely a 'natural leader'
items.subZh: 权威是被接过来的，然后还要去面对它，而不只是'天生领袖'

inline.titleZh: 玛迦星宿的四种常见误读
inline.altEn: Four common misreadings of Magha nakshatra corrected with the inherited-authority framework
inline.altZh: 四种常见的玛迦星宿误读及其纠正

items.subEn: Throne inherited ≠ guaranteed power; Magha points to lineage you carry, not assured outcomes
items.subZh: 王座是继承的，并不等于到手的权力；它指向你背着的那脉血缘

items.subEn: Ketu rules Magha; authority looks backward into ancestry, not upward into status
items.subZh: 主管它的是计都；这里的权威回望祖先，而不是向上攀附地位

items.subEn: Ketu's detachment runs underneath; standing often comes with ambivalence about the legacy
items.subZh: 计都的疏离一直潜在底下；这份地位常常带着对传承的矛盾心情

items.subEn: The frame is identical for anyone — check inherited dignity first, then how they carry it
items.subZh: 框架对谁都一样——先看那份继承来的体面，再读这个人怎么背着它
